examples.en: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
examples.zh: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

examples.en: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
examples.zh: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

examples.en: The UN will allow the use of force against aircraft violating the zone.
examples.zh: 联合国将允许对侵犯这一地区的飞机采取军事行动。

examples.en: The road to the zoo turns off here.
examples.zh: 通向动物园的路由这儿拐弯。

examples.en: The parrots in the zoo are popping all the time.
examples.zh: 动物园里的鹦鹉一直在生小鹦鹉。

examples.en: Lionesses bearing cubs in the zoo is nothing new now.
examples.zh: 狮子在动物园繁殖早已屡见不鲜了。
